description: This file defines the interface for message handling in the rbus core component, including functions for initializing, referencing, and manipulating rbusMessage objects, with support for various data types.

methods.name: rbusMessage_Retain
methods.description: Increases the reference count of an rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count of an rbusMessage and frees it if count reaches zero.

methods.name: rbusMessage_FromBytes
methods.description: Creates an rbusMessage from a byte buffer.

methods.name: rbusMessage_ToDebugString
methods.description: Generates a human-readable debug string for an rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetString
methods.description: Sets a string value in the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array in the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetBytes
methods.description: Gets a byte array from the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetInt32
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit integer in the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetInt32
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit integer from the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetUInt32
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned 32-bit integer from the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetInt64
methods.description: Sets a 64-bit integer in the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetInt64
methods.description: Retrieves a 64-bit integer from the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetDouble
methods.description: Sets a double-precision floating point number in the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_GetDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double value from the rbusMessage.

methods.name: rbusMessage_SetMessage
methods.description: Sets a nested rbusMessage within another.
